verdict.rationale: Only evidence is a community comment mentioning running Jira on-prem, implying a self-hosted option exists but with performance caveats (e.g., Lucene index issues); there is no first-party documentation of a self-hosted/open-source edition, licensing, or install instructions in the pack. missing for 10: official self-hosting/Data Center documentation, deployment guides, licensing terms, independent corroboration of feature parity with cloud.
